[docs/studio.md#security]
- It binds to `127.0.0.1` by default. - Every API call needs the session token from the printed URL. Anyone who has that URL has full access, so don't share it. A new token is generated each time studio starts. - Requests with a foreign `Host` header (DNS rebinding) or a cross-site `Origin` are refused, and bodies are capped at 2 MiB. - The file editor only reaches files inside the project. It never touches `.pskit/`, `.git/`, `.venv/`, `node_modules/` or `__pycache__`, and refuses binary files or files over 1 MiB. - Deploy commands run as `python -m py_serverless_kit ...` with explicit arguments, never through a shell.

[docs/studio.md#what-you-can-do]
Every edit goes into an in-memory draft and is validated as you type (the same checks as `pskit validate`, for the provider and stage you pick in the top bar). Problems link to the field they concern. **Save** (Ctrl/Cmd+S) writes `pskit.yml`; undo/redo work across pages. Nothing touches disk until you save, and closing the tab with unsaved changes asks first.
